taxonomy.note: Accepted by current Kew POWO and ITIS. Tradescantia australis is a synonym. Older treatments also placed Tradescantia eglandulosa here, but Turner 2006 instead treats T. eglandulosa as a synonym of T. humilis.

target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Kew confirms Texas nativity and NPSOT maps broad Texas ecoregion presence, but Turner 2006 characterizes T. hirsutiflora as common mainly in east Texas and largely east of the Edwards Plateau. The historical Gillespie T. eglandulosa record is taxonomically disputed and is not counted.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Need three exact target-zone county records under a stable current T. hirsutiflora concept.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not convert broad NPSOT ecoregion mapping or disputed T. eglandulosa synonymy into exact target-zone counties.

morphology.look_here_first: Hairyflower spiderwort has narrow hairy leaves and stems, hairy floral bracts/sepals, and notably slender fibrous roots rather than thickened tuberous roots.
diagnostic_traits: hairy green floral bracts and sepals
